items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: So at the time I was playing with Johnny McDonnelly. But finally, I picked up on a fine piano man, Don O'Neill.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had good rhythm there. You ever play with a butterfly piano player? What you call a voodoo bell?

Oh! Oh! Oh! I played with one of those. I played with one of those again. The guys at some, uh, country club there. Boy, I thought the night would never end. We'd ask him to call if he wanted the butterfly. That was it. And then we had another drum player beside him. He was trying to play solos on the drums. I don't know when. So there was no rhythm at all. So we must think we lost that job. It was a battle and you lost, huh? Yeah, I know. So at the time I was playing with Johnny McDonnelly. But finally, I picked…
Does he drive a bus or what?
